tasks.label: build: runtime
tasks.command: source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && colcon build --merge-install --packages-select video_interfaces video_ingest mqtt_bridge custom_byteblock video_decode video_viewer_qt --cmake-args -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release

tasks.label: run: udp ingest
tasks.command: source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && source install/setup.bash && export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="${workspaceFolder}/install/lib:${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:-}" && export CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH="${workspaceFolder}/install:${CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH:-}" && export AMENT_PREFIX_PATH="${workspaceFolder}/install:${AMENT_PREFIX_PATH:-}" && exec ${workspaceFolder}/install/lib/video_ingest/udp_ingest_node

tasks.label: run: mqtt bridge
tasks.command: source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && source install/setup.bash && export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="${workspaceFolder}/install/lib:${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:-}" && export CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH="${workspaceFolder}/install:${CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH:-}" && export AMENT_PREFIX_PATH="${workspaceFolder}/install:${AMENT_PREFIX_PATH:-}" && exec ${workspaceFolder}/install/lib/mqtt_bridge/mqtt_bridge_node

tasks.label: run: custom byteblock
tasks.command: source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && source install/setup.bash && export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="${workspaceFolder}/install/lib:${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:-}" && export CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH="${workspaceFolder}/install:${CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH:-}" && export AMENT_PREFIX_PATH="${workspaceFolder}/install:${AMENT_PREFIX_PATH:-}" && exec ${workspaceFolder}/install/lib/custom_byteblock/custom_byteblock_node

tasks.label: run: decoder
tasks.command: source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && source install/setup.bash && export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="${workspaceFolder}/install/lib:${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:-}" && export CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH="${workspaceFolder}/install:${CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH:-}" && export AMENT_PREFIX_PATH="${workspaceFolder}/install:${AMENT_PREFIX_PATH:-}" && exec ${workspaceFolder}/install/lib/video_decode/decoder_node

tasks.label: run: viewer
tasks.command: source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && source install/setup.bash && export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="${workspaceFolder}/install/lib:${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:-}" && export CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH="${workspaceFolder}/install:${CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH:-}" && export AMENT_PREFIX_PATH="${workspaceFolder}/install:${AMENT_PREFIX_PATH:-}" && exec ${workspaceFolder}/install/lib/video_viewer_qt/video_viewer_qt

tasks.label: run: all
tasks.command: source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && source install/setup.bash && export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="${workspaceFolder}/install/lib:${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:-}" && export CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH="${workspaceFolder}/install:${CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH:-}" && export AMENT_PREFIX_PATH="${workspaceFolder}/install:${AMENT_PREFIX_PATH:-}" && ( ${workspaceFolder}/install/lib/video_ingest/udp_ingest_node & ${workspaceFolder}/install/lib/video_decode/decoder_node & ${workspaceFolder}/install/lib/video_viewer_qt/video_viewer_qt & wait -n )
